name: Auto-Close PIDs (PySide6)
description: Cross-platform Qt app to schedule graceful process termination: live process list, multi-schedule support, and a tested MVC architecture.
longDescription: A PySide6 desktop utility that lists running processes and schedules delayed termination after a user-defined interval. Users select targets explicitly, prefer graceful shutdown before force-kill, and can run several independent schedules. The app uses a clear MVC structure with automated unit tests around scheduling and process introspection. Auto-refresh keeps the process list current during long waits.
features: Live process list with multi-select and periodic refresh
Delayed termination in seconds, minutes, or hours
Multiple independent schedules with visible status
Graceful terminate with escalation to force-kill
MVC structure separating UI, control, and process services
Comprehensive unit test suite for core scheduling logic
highlights: Useful for freeing resources after long-running jobs
Cross-platform codebase with tested scheduling core
Explicit user intent before any destructive action
challenges: Process termination is risky if misconfigured or run with high privileges.
solutions: Visible targets, confirmations for destructive schedules, least-privilege execution, and tests on scheduling behaviour.
security: Run with least privilege on shared machines
Treat process lists as sensitive on multi-user hosts
